visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a white patterned top, stands in a brightly lit television studio. She holds a small, clear perfume bottle in her hands, looking at it with a smile. The background is a mix of white and pink panels with cosmetic products on shelves. (2) The camera cuts to a man wearing a grey sweatshirt with 'CELINE' printed on the front. He holds the same perfume bottle, gesturing with his hands and moving his mouth expressively as if talking. His facial expressions are animated. (3) A group shot shows several people in the studio reacting with surprise. They are leaning in towards the center, where one person is smelling a scent. The lighting is bright and even across the stage. (4) Close-up on the man's hands as he swaps the first bottle for a small pink solid stick container. Graphic overlays with price information and icons appear around the object. (5) A woman in a white blazer speaks to the camera, touching her face and jewelry. (6) The man returns to the frame holding a large white lotion bottle with a pump dispenser, presenting it clearly to the viewers.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced, cheerful synth-pop music plays as a male voice speaks with high energy and clarity. A metallic 'ding' sound effect punctuates the start of a sentence. (2) The male speaker's pitch rises as he describes a high price, followed by a chorus of surprised female laughter and overlapping chatter. (3) A digital 'whoosh' transition leads into the next phase where the male speaker continues at a high speech rate, accompanied by a consistent percussive beat. (4) Short cartoon-style 'boing' or 'pop' sound effects are used to highlight visual text appearing on screen. The vocal tone remains highly enthusiastic and promotional throughout the track.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Problem (High Price) -> Solution (Affordable Dupe) -> Comparison -> Conclusion.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to introduce affordable alternatives ('dupes') for high-end luxury perfumes and lotions. It uses the energetic environment of a variety show to demonstrate that low-cost products can have scent profiles nearly identical to luxury brands, emphasizing high 'CP value' (cost-performance ratio).
